verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS, so operating it through natural-language commands is a fair axis. The evidence shows APIs, UI clicks, configurable workflows and a vague reference to 'agents' moving cases, but nothing documents a natural-language command interface. The llms.txt file is LLM-readable documentation, not a way to operate the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
